nodes.name: jest-llm.json

nodes.languageNotes: Single root package.json drives the entire monorepo-style app via Next.js scripts and Jest test selectors.

nodes.summary: Second HD Pack V rubric snapshot used as a comparison fixture alongside packv_hd.json for visual scorer regression testing.

nodes.name: packv_silent.json
nodes.summary: Pack V scorer output for a silent (no-speech) video fixture, used to validate visual-only path of the rubric engine.

nodes.name: packv_silent2.json
nodes.summary: Second silent-video Pack V snapshot used for cross-run consistency checks of the visual rubric scorer.

nodes.name: packv_speech.json
nodes.summary: Pack V rubric snapshot for a speech-containing video, exercising the dialogue-aware branch of the visual scorer.

nodes.name: packv_test.json

nodes.name: packv_test2.json

nodes.summary: Verification payload listing trending sounds harvested by the sound ETL job, used for QA review of audio ingestion correctness.

nodes.name: status.json
nodes.summary: Local status sentinel file containing minimal runtime/job state for ad-hoc inspection.

nodes.name: test_videos.json

nodes.name: transcription-progress.json

nodes.name: tsconfig.demo.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration scoped to the demo build, extending the root tsconfig with demo-specific include/exclude paths.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript compiler configuration for the Trendzo Next.js app, defining compilerOptions, project include globs, and exclude rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Next.js convention: tsconfig.json is auto-detected and configures TS strictness and path aliases across the App Router.

nodes.name: validation_results.json
nodes.summary: Raw per-test prediction-validation results capturing model predictions, expected outcomes, and confidence metrics for analysis.

nodes.name: validation_summary.json
nodes.summary: Aggregated validation summary with total tests, success/failure counts, MAE, within-10-points hit rate, accuracy percentage, and average confidence.

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration declaring framework (Next.js), install/build commands, and six scheduled cron jobs covering recency decay, weekly check-in, atlas feedback, cultural scan, event classification, and overnight triage.
nodes.languageNotes: Crons declared here are activated only on Vercel; local scheduler.ts is not the production path.

nodes.name: training_data.csv
nodes.summary: Minimal placeholder training-data CSV (two rows) used to validate ML training script wiring before real datasets are wired in.
